answer: One enforceable rule: sample three unrelated data feeds and require independent corroboration. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The terrace of work and the horizon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a basalt to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
